name: guitar_distorted
description: Distorted electric guitar — amp mic (SM57, ribbon, etc.)
notes: Distortion compresses everything — noise floor metric is unreliable (low DR is expected, not a problem). HP at 100 Hz removes bleed without killing guitar body. Cut 300-500 Hz to remove cardboard/boxy tone common on SM57 recordings. Be careful with 4-6 kHz — too much sizzle is fatiguing. Do NOT apply broadband denoising.
